samples.text: This Agreement is entered into by and between Acme Corp ('Vendor') and Example LLC ('Customer'). Vendor shall provide the services described in Exhibit A. Customer shall pay Vendor within thirty (30) days of invoice. This Agreement may be terminated by either party upon sixty (60) days written notice. Vendor's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid in the preceding twelve months.

LEASE AGREEMENT. Landlord hereby leases to Tenant the premises described below for a term of twelve months. Tenant agrees to pay monthly rent of $1,500 on the first day of each month. Either party may renew this lease for an additional term upon mutual written consent. Failure to pay rent within five days of the due date constitutes default.

System Requirements Specification. 3.1 Functional Requirements: The system shall authenticate users via OAuth2. 3.2 Non-Functional Requirements: The system shall respond to API requests within 200ms at the 95th percentile. 3.3 Security Requirements: All data at rest shall be encrypted using AES-256. 3.4 Integration Requirements: The system shall expose a REST API documented via OpenAPI 3.0.

Interface Control Document for the Telemetry Subsystem. The subsystem shall transmit sensor readings every 500 milliseconds over a redundant CAN bus. Message payloads shall conform to the schema defined in Appendix B. The subsystem shall tolerate a single point of failure without loss of telemetry continuity. Firmware updates shall be delivered over-the-air with cryptographic signature verification.
